scripts.start:dev: npm run build:deps && CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=1 CHOKIDAR_INTERVAL=3000 tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.build:deps: npm --prefix ../packages/app-config run build && npm --prefix ../packages/unas-json-client run build
scripts.generate-schemas: ts-json-schema-generator --path src/types/DataConnectionRepository.interface.ts --type HttpConnectionConfig -o src/schemas/connection-config-http.schema.json && ts-json-schema-generator --path src/types/DataConnectionRepository.interface.ts --type SftpConnectionConfig -o src/schemas/connection-config-sftp.schema.json && ts-json-schema-generator --path src/types/DataConnectionRepository.interface.ts --type CsvDataFormatConfig -o src/schemas/connection-data-format-config-csv.schema.json && ts-json-schema-generator --path src/types/DataConnectionRepository.interface.ts --type XmlDataFormatConfig -o src/schemas/connection-data-format-config-xml.schema.json && ts-json-schema-generator --path src/types/DataConnectionRepository.interface.ts --type HttpCredentials -o src/schemas/connection-credentials-http.schema.json && ts-json-schema-generator --path src/types/DataConnectionRepository.interface.ts --type SftpCredentials -o src/schemas/connection-credentials-sftp.schema.json && ts-json-schema-generator --path src/types/DataConnectionRepository.interface.ts --type ConnectionTestResult -o src/schemas/connection-test-result.schema.json && ts-json-schema-generator --path src/types/MappingRepository.interface.ts --type StockMappingItems -o src/schemas/stock-mapping-items.schema.json && ts-json-schema-generator --path src/types/MappingRepository.interface.ts --type MappingRules -o src/schemas/mapping-rules.schema.json && ts-json-schema-generator --path src/types/MappingRepository.interface.ts --type MappingSchedule -o src/schemas/mapping-schedule.schema.json
scripts.build: npm run build:deps && npm run generate-schemas && tsc && cpx "src/schemas/*.json" dist/schemas/
